children: While drier weather conditions warrant monitoring, elevated crude palm oil prices are expected to persist through 2H amid tightening supply and resilient demand, Hong Leong IB analyst Chye Wen Fei says in a note. Drier conditions could affect yields with a lag, but it is too early to assess the impact, she says. Near-term oleochemical demand should remain supported by restocking amid geopolitical uncertainty and ahead of the implementation of the European Union Deforestation Regulation, she adds. Hong Leong maintains an overweight rating on Malaysian plantation sector, pegging IOI Corp. and Hap Seng Plantations as top picks. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
